title: review follow-ups of PR #37743
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7207845228 and 7208869311 on PR #37743, nits N2, N3 and N4 and an out-of-diff note, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37743 (Fixes #37677) made a `repeater` field on `span: 'auto'` take the whole row on the record form, on `/forms/NAME` and on the form designer canvas. It reads the object field's declared type through `WIDE_DECLARED_FIELD_TYPES` in `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`. Its review left these open:

- [ ] **The parity pin cannot see the declared rule** (N2). app-shell's `richtextSurfaceParity` compares only the type-only wide sets of the form and the detail view. It stays green now that the two differ for a repeater (wide on the form, one cell on the detail view, by design). The multi-file rule has a plugin-detail twin, and this rule has none. Expected: the pin names the declared leg and asserts the intended difference, so a future drift in either direction goes red.
- [ ] **The designer canvas drops `multiple`** (N4). `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` passes `{ type }` to `resolveColSpan` without `multiple`, so a file or image field that declares `multiple: true` takes one cell on the canvas but the whole row on the runtime form. This predates #37743, and the "cannot drift" comment in `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` is not true of the multi-file rule. Expected: the canvas passes `multiple`, with a pin and a single-file control.
- [ ] **Docblock example** (N3). The `WIDE_DECLARED_FIELD_TYPES` docblock gives the designer as its example of a bare name on `FormField.type`, but the designer reaches the rule through the stash leg. The plugin-form test titled "the form designer passes one" exercises the `type` leg. Expected: name the right caller, or retitle the test.
- [ ] **The metadata-form renderer ignores `span`** (out of the diff). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` renders metadata forms from the same `FormFieldSchema` and sizes a row from `colSpan` alone. It reads neither `span` nor any wide default, so the spec's "the renderer sizes the field…" is not true there, before or after #37743. This was read, not run. Expected: either SchemaForm honours `span` through the shared resolver, or the spec `span` describe names the renderers it binds. Reproduce first.

Priority: p3. These are layout and pin-accuracy gaps. Nothing loses data, and an author can set `colSpan` or `span: 'full'` today.
Business reason: designers see a different layout on the canvas than users get at runtime, and the guard that should catch form/detail drift is blind to one rule.
Reader: the ux lane thread that next edits `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts` or the form designer.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37743"` (0 hits) and `SchemaForm span colSpan` (no match).
Related: #37677, PR #37743.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read · evidence: read → p3
